items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms in residential buildings need 2.5 m clear height, 2.2 m over at most half the area or in attics.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at zakonyprolidi.cz (consolidated official text of decree 146/2024); may drop to 2.2 m over up to half the floor area

items.paraphrase: Total glazed area of habitable rooms is at least one tenth of their floor area.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at zakonyprolidi.cz (consolidated official text of decree 146/2024); sum of window openings at least one tenth of floor area

items.paraphrase: Main doors to flats, rooms and internal circulation have a clear passage of at least 0.8 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at zakonyprolidi.cz (consolidated official text of decree 146/2024); applies to main entrance doors of dwellings and building circulation

items.paraphrase: Shared corridors in apartment buildings are at least 1.2 m wide; the older barrier-free rule asked 1.5 m on pedestrian routes.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at zakonyprolidi.cz (consolidated official text of decree 146/2024); clear width of common corridors in apartment buildings, with manoeuvring space for wheelchair users at accessible dwellings

items.paraphrase: Barrier-free flats for severe mobility impairment need a 1.5 m turning circle in all rooms.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 at zakonyprolidi.cz (consolidated official text of decree 146/2024); wheelchair-standard dwelling, circle in every room

items.paraphrase: Barrier-free ramp slope up to 1:16; a 3 m ramp in a renovation may go to 1:8.
items.note: unverifiable_free: read 2026-11-14: zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/2024-146; no accessible-ramp slope in the decree (sec. 31(1) gives 12.5 percent for escape-route ramps); accessibility detail is in paywalled CSN 73 4001

items.paraphrase: Main stairs in family houses are at least 0.9 m clear wide (0.75 m for auxiliary stairs).
items.note: unverifiable_free: read 2026-11-14: zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/2024-146; no stair width figure for family houses found; 0.9 m existed only in repealed 268/2009

items.clause: Sec. 46(1)/(3): clear height of permanent work rooms 2.50 m up to 20 m2, 2.60 m up to 50 m2; offices may use reduced heights but at least 2.60 m
items.paraphrase: Workplace regulation sets 2.6 m minimum clear height for offices under the reduction rule and for small work rooms.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/2007-361; workplace rule, not decree 146/2024; larger rooms need 2.70 to 3.25 m unless the office reduction applies
